title: dependency:tree -Dverbose：重复与被裁剪的节点
expected_output:
=== mvn dependency:tree -Dverbose (simulated) ===
app:1.0
+- lib-b:1.0
|  +- lib-c:1.0   (omitted for conflict with lib-c:2.0)
|  \- lib-d:1.0
+- lib-c:2.0
|  \- lib-d:2.0   (omitted for conflict with lib-d:1.0)
+- lib-e:1.0
|  \- lib-b:1.0   (omitted for duplicate)
\- lib-f:1.0

=== which node wins, and why ===
  lib-c:2.0  depth=1  beats lib-c:1.0  depth=2   (nearest wins)
  lib-d:1.0  depth=2  beats lib-d:2.0  depth=2   (same depth -> declared first)
  lib-b:1.0  the 2nd occurrence has the SAME version -> duplicate, not conflict

legend: omitted-for-conflict  = same artifact, DIFFERENT version lost
        omitted-for-duplicate = exact same gav is already on the classpath
